excludedInterSampleDiagnostics.reason: The first cohort is mathematically unable to meet the strict audit p99 bound; drain the current measurement before an isolated attribution-bookkeeping diagnostic.
excludedInterSampleDiagnostics.result: Neither attribution nor owner polling proved a reliable fix. Product source remains frozen at 97c1a8bc1; complete all scheduled cohorts.

excludedInterSampleDiagnostics.reason: Drain the current unchanged sample before isolating periodic worker-health supervision.
excludedInterSampleDiagnostics.result: Heartbeat ablation was not a reliable improvement. Keep verified health supervision and complete all 108 scheduled samples.

excludedInterSampleDiagnostics.reason: Drain current sample before isolating the separate guardian owner poll.
excludedInterSampleDiagnostics.result: Guardian owner-poll ablation was not an improvement. Keep verified ownership and finish all 108 scheduled samples.

excludedPartialSamples.reason: Previous owned collection was interrupted before summary, final rows and teardown. A fresh complete run supplies the scheduled slot.

excludedSetupFailures.reason: Bun refused copying a symlink seed before the fixture Viewer started. The resumed seed was copied and its bytes verified against the frozen manifest.

measurementMethod.recovery: Original mutation tools retried with original arguments and request keys after drain, at most 19 concurrently under a 300-second whole-recovery budget. Original reply and timing records are retained. API retry counters and forensic SQL effects are separate observations; per-attempt recovery timestamps were not recorded.
measurementMethod.processGone: Observed runtime births minus post-teardown survivors, supported by empty private-namespace teardown. Native exit timestamps were not recorded.
measurementMethod.callCounters: Original measured offers; completed includes settled failures. SQL counters use observation time; call phases use offered time.
measurementMethod.comparison: Full numeric row revisions and durable columns retained. Analysis version 4 independently checks committed SQL predecessors, all call counts, successful list pages, original mutation replies and update deltas against their committed predecessors; normalization remains version 2.
measurementMethod.loopWindow: Runtime completedWindow records coverage of the nominal tail. It does not prove an on-time histogram reset. First/last and scheduled timestamps, reset delay, end delay and observed interval are retained. A late callback can exclude early nominal work or include drain work; missing histogram observations are not reconstructed.
